subject: Nightingale sec posture discovery — private/VPC options, SOC 2 timing & next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emma Carter <emma@nightingalehealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: security@nightingalehealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nightingale sec posture discovery — private/VPC options, SOC 2 timing & next steps

Hi Emma / Nightingale team — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and concrete next steps from Redwood: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance status
- You mentioned the company is working toward SOC 2 Type II and expect a final report in Q4 2026. Please confirm whether we should expect an interim SOC 2 Type I or an ISO/other attest in the meantime.

2) Data protection scope (GDPR / HIPAA)
- Please confirm HIPAA applicability for the workloads you expect us to host. From the call it sounded like PHI will be in scope for models touching clinical notes.

3) Deployment posture & isolation options requested by your infra team
- Private VPC with no public egress (preferred)
- Air-gapped on-prem option for pilot environment (we outlined differences on call)
- Network diagram and example architecture to review (we can provide 2-3 templates)

4) Vendor security questionnaire + artifacts
- Attaching a fillable vendor questionnaire to start (redwood-vendor-questionnaire-fillable.pdf). If you prefer, we can host the questionnaire link for your security team to complete.

Action items / owners:
- Emma / Nightingale: confirm HIPAA scope and point person for procurement/security (email + phone) — ideally someone who can receive the questionnaire.
- Nightingale infra / security: share any current network constraints (VPN/Direct Connect, allowed IP ranges, egress rules) and a current network diagram if available.
- Markus (solutions): will prepare 2 architecture sketches (VPC-hybrid, fully air-gapped) + short notes on expected integration effort and estimated timeline.
- Priyom (sales engineering): to prep pricing outline for Dedicated vs Private options once network constraints are known.

Proposed next touch: Tue Jun 16 10:00 AM PT for follow-up with infra and procurement. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda.

Thanks — attaching the questionnaire and a blank network sketch (network-sketch-v1.png) for your infra team to annotate.

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Emma Carter <emma@nightingalehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Infra Team <infra@nightingalehealth.com>, security@nightingalehealth.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nightingale sec posture discovery — private/VPC options, SOC 2 timing & next steps

Thanks Soojin — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we do not have an active Type II yet. We completed SOC 2 Type I in late 2025 and are actively working on the Type II audit; target delivery is 2026-11-30 (Q4). We can share the Type I report now and will share auditor contact details for Type II once available.

- HIPAA / data scope: confirmed — PHI will be in scope for the pilot and production. We will need Business Associate Agreement language and specific audit logs (login, admin actions, data access).

- Network constraints: we currently use a mix of Direct Connect and VPN into our VPCs. Egress is restricted; only specific partner endpoints are whitelisted via static IPs. We'll need a private, non-internet-facing solution for model inference.

Attaching our internal infosec requirements doc to this thread (nightingale-infosec-requirements.docx). I'll loop in our security manager (security@nightingalehealth.com) to start the questionnaire review.

We'd like to see the two architecture sketches you mentioned, and specifically whether Redwood supports: 
- Deployment with no public egress (forced egress via a private NAT or proxy inside our DMZ)
- An air-gapped option for a small pilot cluster (no outbound internet, physical media transfer for model updates)

I can do Tue Jun 16 10:00 AM PT. I'll invite our infra lead + procurement.

-Emma
Emma Carter
Director, Clinical Platforms
Nightingale Health
emma@nightingalehealth.com | +1 617-555-0142

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Emma Carter <emma@nightingalehealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nightingale sec posture discovery — private/VPC options, SOC 2 timing & next steps

Emma — thanks for the detail and the infosec doc. Quoting the key asks below and attaching two sketches (redwood-private-deploy-options.pdf):

> - Deployment with no public egress (forced egress via a private NAT or proxy inside our DMZ)
> - An air-gapped option for a small pilot cluster (no outbound internet, physical media transfer for model updates)

Short answers / feasibility notes:
- Private VPC (preferred): fully supported. We can place inference nodes in your VPC via a customer-managed VPC peering / private endpoints model or host in a Redwood-managed VPC with private connectivity (Direct Connect/VPN). We can restrict egress to your approved proxy/NAT IPs.
- Air-gapped on-prem: feasible for a pilot. Requirements: physical isolation of pilot hardware, offline model bundle transfer process, on-site engineer for initial provisioning, and an agreed change-control process (we'll provide a signed checklist).
- Logging / audit: we capture per-token access logs, admin actions, and can push logs to your Splunk/CloudWatch/Kafka endpoint over a private connection. We'll include a sample audit-log schema in the follow-up.

Open questions for infra/procurement:
- Do you prefer Redwood-hosted Private (we run nodes in a dedicated VPC under strict egress rules) or customer-hosted (we ship an appliance / container bundle to your environment)? Each has different lead times and procurement needs.
- For Direct Connect, do you have a preferred colo / cross-connect partner?

Deliverables from our side (by Mon Jun 15):
- 2x architecture diagrams (VPC-hosted + air-gapped) + high-level BOM
- Short answers doc mapping Nightingale requirements to Redwood controls (GDRP/HIPAA/SOC)
- Vendor questionnaire pre-filled where applicable (we'll send the first pass via Drive link)

Markus

Great — thanks Emma and Markus. Quick consolidated next steps and commitments so everyone has the same expectations: 

1) By EOD Mon Jun 15: Markus to deliver 2 architecture sketches + short BOM + sample audit-log schema (we have that target).
2) By EOD Mon Jun 15: I will upload a pre-filled vendor questionnaire to Drive and share the link for Nightingale to review (link included above).
3) Nightingale: please share current network diagram and point person for procurement (procurement@nightingalehealth.com or reply-all with a contact).
4) BAA: I'll loop Legal once HIPAA is confirmed — we'll attach our standard BAA template and can accept minor redlines.
5) Follow-up call: Tue Jun 16 10:00 AM PT — calendar invite to go out today. Agenda: review architecture sketches, confirm procurement path, and review initial vendor questionnaire items.

If you prefer a short pre-read, I've added the Drive link to a pre-filled questionnaire and a sample architecture doc. Please flag any questions prior to the meeting and we'll have Markus and our security engineer on the call.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.
